subject: meta,ddl: support must-load filtering for affinity (#66627)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent focusing on meta/DDL must-load filtering and infoschema v2 resident-table loading. Change introduces `MustLoadFilterAttr` to support presence-based must-load rules and adds an `affinity` marker so tables with `TableInfo.Affinity` become resident under schema-cache mode; DDL placement-policy caller updated to preserve prior behavior. No remaining Blocker/High correctness, consistency, compatibility, concurrency, or metadata/state-machine issues found, and no later fixes on `master` touch the changed files.
